description: This file defines the KubernetesClusterAgent class, which manages cluster configuration synchronization between Orleans and Kubernetes. It handles monitoring of Kubernetes pods, updating pod labels with cluster options, and propagating cluster state changes. It integrates with Kubernetes API through the k8s client library and interacts with Orleans cluster membership service.

classes.name: KubernetesClusterAgent
classes.description: Manages synchronization and monitoring of cluster state between Orleans and Kubernetes, including pod management and membership updates.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the agent to the Orleans silo lifecycle to start and stop monitoring routines.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes monitoring, updates cluster options, queries existing pods, and starts background tasks for cluster and pod monitoring.

methods.name: AddClusterOptionsToPodLabels
methods.description: Ensures the current pod has correct labels reflecting cluster options.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops monitoring tasks, cancels background processes, with a timeout fallback.

methods.name: MonitorOrleansClustering
methods.description: Monitors Orleans cluster membership and manages pod lifecycle based on cluster state.

methods.name: MonitorKubernetesPods
methods.description: Watches Kubernetes pods and updates Orleans cluster membership based on pod lifecycle events.

methods.name: TryMatchSilo
methods.description: Matches a Kubernetes pod to an Orleans cluster member based on the pod's metadata.
